summary.en: Kogoro, along with Conan, is invited to the wedding of the son of a man who met at a bar he frequents, but suddenly the bride, Sayoko Imamura, says that she doesn't feels well and collapses. She was poisoned. Location: Wedding hall Victim: Sayoko Imamura Cause of death: Mushroom poisoning Suspects: Shinpo Yokoyama, Hiroko Nagashima, Alex Harutoshi Kawasu, Gakuto Yamada, Naho Mizuguchi, and Nobuteru Yokoyama After entering the wedding hall, she suddenly says that she doesn't feels well and collapses, dying at the scene. There are numerous suspects that said supsicious things when the murder happened. But who is the real culprit and what is the motive behind this tragedy on a happy day?
